theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_proj_boundary_mass_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (S F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (l + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (l + 1)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (l + 1)), MeasurableSet F → F ⊆ S → (∀ K : Set (Euclid m), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsCompact (S ∩ pL ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ γ : Covector (Euclid m) l, covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (l + 1), Y ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) (l + 1)) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (l + 1), Z ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (l + 1)) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid m), IsOpen W → Y.boundary.massOn W ≤ Z.boundary.massOn (pL ⁻¹' W)
